evidence: Walked instruction.md plus hireops_rules.md line by line against the frozen solution. Every asked-for screen, role and flow has an implementation. RUNTIME: node /app/server.js -> src/index.js -> bootstrap.js, which listens on PORT||3000 on 0.0.0.0 and answers /api/health before the DB worker exists (bootstrap.js:20-26,45). DB_PATH||/app/app.db (db.js:9). Seed is a byte-identical copy beside the module and is loaded once (seedIfEmpty, db.js:61-62). solve.sh copies the app and deletes any DB, so nothing ships pre-built. UI and API come from one process (index.js:42-43,437-441). IDENTITY: cookie session (index.js:68-81), 401/403, and a candidate gets 404 for another's application (index.js:121-131,326-333,378-385). JOBS/CANDIDATES: a recruiter opens a job with title, team, an HM chosen from HM accounts and 1-50 places (index.js:202-214; board.js:61-81). A recruiter adds a candidate to the bottom of Applied (index.js:216-233). Email is validated and duplicates refused case-insensitively; the error is shown at the field and typed values are kept (board.js:47-56; workspace.cjs:307-311). A candidate account is linked by email. BOARD: six stages and one-step moves; reject needs a reason and remembers its origin; reopen goes only to that origin (index.js:238-265). Ordinary Move select/button plus optional drag (board.js:208-243,300-319). Up/Down reorder (board.js:233-241). Interview cap with reordering inside allowed (index.js:290-295). HM limits (index.js:257-264; board.js:144-162). Observer/candidate cannot move. CONCURRENCY: a version mismatch gives a 409 that names the actor via the last activity detail (index.js:241-245). The move shows at once, is put back on refusal with the reason, and focus returns to the card (board.js:166-205). BULK: all-or-nothing in board order with the Interview cap counted for the whole set (index.js:274-321,339-344; board.js:285-290). UNDO: own latest move only, single use, refused if any card version changed or Interview would overfill; restores place and reason, and notes do not bump version (index.js:348-373). NOTES: detail panel, role-gated writes, observer reads, per-person browser note draft (board.js:85-141; index.js:386-398). ACTIVITY: every kind is logged as a readable line, rejection includes the reason, entries are never changed, refused actions roll back. The view is newest first with an All jobs/per-job filter (index.js:195-198,266-271; app.js:45-85). LIVE: SSE 'changed' events after every successful write lead to an in-place keyed patch that keeps the open card, note text, focus and scroll (index.js:45-54,102-107; app.js:130-164; board.js:321-341). CONVERSATIONS: role access (index.js:114-120). Opens on the newest 30 and loads 30 earlier at a time with the remaining count, keeping the anchor (index.js:401-417; threads.js:160-175). The new-message pill leaves draft and scroll alone (threads.js:145-159). Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line, and a failed send keeps the text (threads.js:183-201). Per-person unread counts with a total badge (index.js:132-139; app.js:115-121). Seen/Sent on the sender's latest message, with the observer excluded (index.js:143-156; threads.js:76-90). Drafts are kept per user and conversation in localStorage and survive switching, reload and a session lost on 401 (app.js:34,39-43,189-195; threads.js:112,124,182). CANDIDATE VIEW: own applications with title, team and wording from the seed labels; nothing auto-opens; no notes, reasons, positions or activity (index.js:171-176; threads.js:7,52-53,138-139). VIEWS: Board, Conversations and Activity for staff; 'My applications' for candidates (app.js:87-91).
